title: Learning from Next-Frame Prediction: Towards Unified and Scalable Visual World Modeling
title_zh: 从下一帧预测学习：迈向统一且可扩展的视觉世界建模

paragraphs.en: 提出VANE自监督视觉预训练框架，通过嵌入空间下一帧预测实现统一可扩展的视觉世界建模，多数基准达SOTA。 Video provides a natural source of supervision: what happens next serves as a learning signal for visual world modeling. Yet masked video pretraining focuses on recovering missing content from surrounding context rather than predicting the future from the past. Autoregressive methods instead predict forward one token at a time, but have yet to match joint-embedding methods in representation quality. This gap motivates us to revisit the granularity and space of future prediction. In this work, we introduce VANE, a self-supervised visual pretraining framework built on next-frame prediction in embedding space. A causal encoder summarizes past observations for a state predictor that infers the representation of the entire next frame, making temporal evolution the primary learning signal. This prediction is carried out in a fixed embedding space provided by a frozen semantic tokenizer, emphasizing scene content and structure. To retain fine-grained spatial detail alongside semantic content, a lightweight auxiliary generative decoder reconstructs future-frame patches conditioned on the predicted representations. To unify visual modeling across images and videos, we construct a local-to-global crop sequence for still images, allowing the same encoder to predict newly revealed regions from earlier crops under the same objective. Experiments show that VANE improves with model and data scaling, achieving SOTA on most anticipation, recognition, and dense perception benchmarks among unified encoders. Especially on EPIC-KITCHENS-100 action anticipation, it surpasses V-JEPA 2.1 by 7.1 points in mean-class recall@5. These results demonstrate that next-frame prediction in embedding space is effective and scalable for visual world modeling.
paragraphs.zh: 提出VANE自监督视觉预训练框架，通过嵌入空间下一帧预测实现统一且可扩展的视觉世界建模，在多数基准上达到SOTA。视频提供了一种天然的监督来源：接下来会发生什么，可作为视觉世界建模的学习信号。 然而掩码视频预训练侧重于从周围上下文恢复缺失内容，而非从过去预测未来。 自回归方法则逐token向前预测，但在表征质量上尚未赶上联合嵌入方法。 这一差距促使我们重新审视未来预测的粒度与空间。 在本工作中，我们提出VANE，一个建立在嵌入空间下一帧预测之上的自监督视觉预训练框架。 一个因果编码器总结过去的观测，供状态预测器推断整个下一帧的表征，使时间演化成为主要的学习信号。 该预测在由冻结的语义分词器提供的固定嵌入空间中进行，强调场景内容与结构。 为了在语义内容之外保留细粒度的空间细节，一个轻量的辅助生成解码器以预测的表征为条件重建未来帧的patch。 为了在图像与视频之间统一视觉建模，我们为静态图像构建由局部到全局的裁剪序列，使同一编码器能够在相同目标下从较早的裁剪预测新显露的区域。 实验表明，VANE随模型与数据扩展而提升，在统一编码器中的多数预期、识别与密集感知基准上达到SOTA。 尤其在EPIC-KITCHENS-100动作预期任务上，其mean-class recall@5超过V-JEPA 2.1达7.1个百分点。 这些结果表明，嵌入空间中的下一帧预测对视觉世界建模是有效且可扩展的。
